name: PF Meat Company
old_description: We are passionate about crafting unforgettable moments through food—from our carefully curated butcher case and signature Kitchen creations to our convenient Grab & Go and Take & Bake selections. Our deepest desire is to set the table for a memorable experience.
about:
PF Meat Company operates from its headquarters in Belton, South Carolina, with two retail butcher markets in Pendleton, South Carolina, and Toccoa, Georgia. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The business combines retail butchery with in-house manufacturing. Its USDA-inspected smokehouse produces a line of handcrafted smoked meats including snack sticks, smoked sausages, beef jerky, coil sausage, deli ham, whole hams, Canadian bacon, pulled pork barbecue, and signature smoked and naturally cured bacon. The company also roasts its own coffee in four signature blends—light, medium, dark, and decaf—and runs PF Kitchen at the Pendleton location, serving breakfast and lunch made with locally sourced ingredients. Additionally, PF Meat Company offers whole and half beef shares sourced from its own herd and a network of partner farms across the tri-state area.

The company serves walk-in customers at its two markets, as well as customers placing special orders from the butcher counter. Its products reach consumers seeking locally raised meats, house-roasted coffee, and ready-to-eat meals, all supported by relationships with more than 100 local and regional farms and family businesses.

PF Meat Company states its purpose is to connect people back to the land and the life it produces, strengthening local agriculture and creating spaces where people gather around good food. The "Farmer Approved" ethos emphasizes that every purchase sustains the farms and small businesses that make the region unique.
